scenarios.scenario_abstract: For graduation, [X] fixes a pink floral dress and strappy platform form, then checks the shoe surface as part of the full outfit and from typical photo distance. The surface should either stay understated so the dress remains the focal point, echo one motif at a clearly different scale, or add a restrained accent without competing with the ruffles and jewelry.
examples: using Solid as a quiet base beneath the floral dress
testing Floral or restrained Geometric repetition only when scale and spacing stay distinct from the dress
rejecting a dense Graphic, Cartoon, Camouflage, Tie Dye, Color Block, or Animal Print treatment when it displaces the intended formal focal point
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 确定粉色碎花毕业礼服和绑带厚底鞋型后，[X]会把鞋面放回整套造型中，并从通常的合影距离观察效果。鞋面可以保持低调，让礼服继续成为视觉重点；也可以用明显不同的尺度呼应礼服上的某个图案，或只增加一处克制的点缀，避免与荷叶边和首饰争抢注意力。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After settling on black formal shoes for the army-green suit chosen by the wedding party, [X] checks the pair at normal ceremony and group-photo distance. Any visible texture or contrast should remain subtle enough to preserve the formal dress code and the group's coordinated appearance.
examples: using Solid when the shoe should disappear into the formal base
allowing only low-contrast Geometric texture that still reads as formal from a distance
rejecting conspicuous novelty patterns when they break the agreed group uniform
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为婚礼团队选定的军绿色西装配好黑色正装鞋后，[X]会从仪式现场和集体合影的通常距离观察鞋面。可见纹理或对比需要足够低调，才能维持正式着装要求和团队协调感。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an informal afternoon reunion on a former college campus, [X] keeps a familiar classic-clog preference but checks whether the footwear surface remains deliberate beside a simple sweater and dark jeans after cleaning, rather than making an otherwise polished casual outfit visually noisy.
examples: using Solid to preserve the simple sweater-and-jeans formula
accepting a small Graphic or Cartoon cue only when it reflects the wearer and remains secondary
checking the clogs from normal conversation distance after cleaning
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加母校下午的非正式同学聚会时，[X]仍会保留喜欢穿经典洞洞鞋的习惯，但会在清洁后检查鞋面是否能与简洁毛衣和深色牛仔裤形成有意搭配，而不是让本来利落的休闲造型显得杂乱。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before listing an owned pair online, [X] cleans it, photographs the front, sides, soles, and flaws under consistent light, and writes the surface pattern exactly as it appears so buyers can distinguish an intentional motif or color treatment from dirt, fading, abrasion, or misleading camera color.
examples: documenting Solid, Floral, Camouflage, Cartoon, or Animal Print repeats without redesigning the pair
showing Tie Dye or Color Block transitions in uncropped side and top views
using close-ups for Graphic or Geometric detail and separately disclosing wear
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在网上发布一双自有鞋之前，[X]会先清洁鞋子，在一致光线下拍摄正面、侧面、鞋底和瑕疵，并按实物准确写明鞋面图案，使买家能区分原有纹样或配色处理与污渍、褪色、磨损或相机色差。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When comparing Puma Speedcat ballet sneakers with Adidas Sambas, [X] examines how each shoe's uninterrupted areas, side stripes or formstrip, logo placement, and contrasting panels look with the jeans, skirts, trousers, or trend-led outfits intended for repeated wear with the pair.
examples: using Solid when versatility matters more than model recognition
using Color Block or Geometric side regions to keep a recognizable slim-sneaker identity
treating a small Graphic brand mark as one element rather than calling the whole shoe printed
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在 Puma Speedcat 芭蕾鞋型和 Adidas Samba 之间比较时，[X]会观察大块连续鞋面、侧条或弧形标识、品牌位置和对比拼片如何与计划反复搭配的牛仔裤、裙子、长裤或潮流造型共同呈现。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With limited styling experience, [X] builds a cloudy-day outfit around an owned thin black bomber and dark monochrome base, then compares boots or sneakers by whether a plain surface would extend the reusable dark foundation or a restrained pattern would provide the outfit's only clear contrast.
examples: using Solid black to extend the monochrome line
using a restrained Color Block or Geometric panel as the single visual break
avoiding a dense Graphic or multicolored treatment when bright socks or a beanie already provide the accent
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 围绕自有的薄黑色飞行夹克和深色单色内搭构建阴天造型时，[X]虽然不熟悉穿搭，仍会比较靴子或运动鞋应采用素净鞋面来延续可复用的深色基础，还是用克制图案为整套低调层搭提供唯一明显的对比。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an R&B stadium concert, [X] chooses supportive sneakers or broken-in boots for concrete ramps, stairs, standing, and dancing, then checks the shoe surface against a possible graphic top, jewelry, secure pockets, and the venue's clear-bag constraints so comfort gear still looks intentional.
examples: using Solid when the top, chains, or clear-bag hardware already carries the visual energy
using Graphic or Color Block footwear as the focal point with otherwise quiet clothes
checking from standing distance and under stadium lighting rather than choosing only from a close product image
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加体育场 R&B 演唱会时，[X]会为水泥坡道、楼梯、久站和跳舞选择有支撑的运动鞋或已磨合靴子，再把鞋面与可能出现的图案上衣、首饰、安全口袋和透明包规则一起检查，使舒适装备仍显得有意搭配。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While searching for white shoes for a garden wedding, [X] compares surface treatments in daylight beside an already purchased brown dress, balancing formal photographs, grass and dirt visibility, cleanability, and the risk that a large or dense motif makes the required wide construction look busier.
examples: using Solid for a clean formal base that makes dirt easy to inspect
using Floral or restrained Geometric detail when it remains legible and wedding-appropriate
evaluating pattern placement only after true width and grass stability are satisfied
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为花园婚礼寻找白鞋时，[X]会在已购棕色礼服旁于日光下比较鞋面处理，同时权衡正式合影、草地和泥渍显眼程度、清洁难度，以及大面积密集纹样让所需宽楦结构更显繁复的风险。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning a recognizable Tracer cosplay, [X] compares dark ankle boots and tests whether a light edge, separated panels, or a small stencil remains recognizable after flexing and wear without drawing attention away from the jacket, leggings, goggles, and props.
examples: using Solid for the donor boot before modification
using Color Block or Geometric separation for the controlled light-on-dark edge treatment
using Graphic or Cartoon-like character marking only where a small stencil remains readable
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 规划可辨识的 Tracer cosplay 时，[X]会比较深色踝靴，并测试浅色边饰、分区拼片或小型模板图案在弯折和磨损后是否仍可辨识，同时避免它们抢走夹克、紧身裤、护目镜和道具的注意力。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After choosing a denim jacket for a spring-and-autumn minimalist wardrobe, [X] narrows the footwear to classic black or white sneakers and checks whether their surface treatment stays understated beside changing neutral layers, a red cap, a pearl necklace, and a simple bag.
examples: using Solid as the repeatable minimalist baseline
allowing a small Graphic logo or restrained Color Block panel when it stays secondary
rejecting pattern density that violates the user's explicit not-too-busy rule
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为春秋极简衣橱选定牛仔夹克后，[X]会把鞋履范围缩小到经典黑色或白色运动鞋，并检查鞋面处理与变化的中性色层搭、红色帽子、珍珠项链和简洁包袋放在一起时是否足够低调。
